item.title: Targeted Investment Aims to Strengthen Island Communities and Futures
item.description: Targeted Scottish Government funding will support 16 community led projects across Scotland’s islands, including a new facility for young carers on Skye, as part of efforts to strengthen island infrastructure, tackle depopulation and secure sustainable local futures.The post Targeted Investment Aims to Strengthen Island Communities and Futures appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Urges Return to Erasmus and Calls for Honest Reckoning on Brexit
item.description: The SNP has urged the UK Government to secure a return to the Erasmus programme, arguing the talks underline the damage Brexit has caused to Scotland’s students and universities and calling for an honest reckoning over taking Scotland out of the EU.The post SNP Urges Return to Erasmus and Calls for Honest Reckoning on Brexit appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Growing Popularity of Running Increases Demand for 2026 Inverness Half Marathon
item.description: Organisers of the Inverness Half Marathon are anticipating record demand in 2026 as running continues to grow in popularity, with event changes planned to improve safety, support charities and strengthen the race’s role in Inverness and the wider Highlands.The post Growing Popularity of Running Increases Demand for 2026 Inverness Half Marathon appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: AES Solar Apprentices Claim Top Honours at Highlands and Islands Awards
item.description: Two apprentices from Highland renewables firm AES Solar have taken top honours at the 2025 Highlands and Islands Apprenticeship Awards, highlighting the company’s long term commitment to developing skilled careers and supporting the region’s clean energy future.The post AES Solar Apprentices Claim Top Honours at Highlands and Islands Awards appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Dornoch Music and Beer Festival Set to Return Bigger and Bolder in 2026
item.description: Dornoch prepares for a bigger summer as the Music and Beer Festival returns in July 2026 with major headliners, an expanded stage, Highland food and drink, and a strong family focus, cementing its place as one of the Highlands’ standout live events.The post Dornoch Music and Beer Festival Set to Return Bigger and Bolder in 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Garmouth Viaduct Closed After Partial Collapse Over River Spey
item.description: The sudden closure of the Garmouth Viaduct after a partial collapse has left communities along the River Spey reeling, raising urgent safety concerns and questions about the future of a much loved walking and cycling route.The post Garmouth Viaduct Closed After Partial Collapse Over River Spey appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ross County Part Company With Tony Docherty and Callum Davidson After Raith Rovers Defeat
item.description: Ross County have parted company with manager Tony Docherty and assistant Callum Davidson after a damaging 6 to 0 defeat at Raith Rovers, a result that brought mounting pressure to a head and leaves the club searching for stability and direction.The post Ross County Part Company With Tony Docherty and Callum Davidson After Raith Rovers Defeat appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Immigration Plans Could Cost UK £10.8 Billion SNP Warns
item.description: Scotland’s care sector faces fresh uncertainty as UK Government immigration plans are projected to cost £10.8 billion, with the SNP warning the loss of workers and revenue could deepen staff shortages and economic pressure across Scotland.The post Labour Immigration Plans Could Cost UK £10.8 Billion SNP Warns appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Fort Augustus Fish and Chip Shop Wins Prestigious UK Industry Award
item.description: A Fort Augustus fish and chip shop has earned national recognition after winning a prestigious UK industry award, highlighting Highland talent, quality food, and a local business making its mark on the national stage.The post Fort Augustus Fish and Chip Shop Wins Prestigious UK Industry Award appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Hebridean Whale and Dolphin Trust Celebrates Double Win at ScottishPower Foundation Awards
item.description: An Isle of Mull marine charity has secured £15,000 after a double success at the ScottishPower Foundation Awards, recognising innovative education and conservation work that is inspiring communities and protecting whales and dolphins along Scotland’s west coast.The post Hebridean Whale and Dolphin Trust Celebrates Double Win at ScottishPower Foundation Awards appeared first on The Highland Times.
